timeout_policy: Stop with TIMEOUT_NOT_RUN; no smaller fixture, larger timeout, or retry
fixed_fixtures: Every prefix length with host aliases; full capacity and replacement, deletion fallback, absent full insert, two insertion orders, 360 seeded mixed commands per profile; S1 K1 additionally all729 three-command sequences from nine choices, each preceded by CLEAR
reset_policy: Fourteen observed-phase immediate resets per profile covering all eight states, held successful/error responses, interior scan/clear, replacement write and clear of live table. Every cancellation followed by checked nontrivial insert/query/replace/delete/fallback/clear recovery.
stalls: Hold all main responses at least four clocks; actual blocked source and response cycles counted; complete source/response hold assertions
oracle: Unbounded dictionary indexed by canonical interval identity; interval containment sorted by specificity; complete physical snapshot after every main response
